tools.name: analyse_transcript
tools.description:
Compare one speaker in a meeting transcript with public founder and operator interviews and return the
        report as data: speaking type, style positions, similar well-known people, standout habits and takeaways.

        transcript: the complete prepared transcript, never just a file preview, one speaker turn per line
        ("Name: words"). Restricted information must be removed before transfer, as described in the server instructions;
        a user-selected excerpt is allowed. speaker: one speaker label as it appears in the text.
        name: the person's display name when the label is generic (Me, Them, Speaker 2), or "You" when
        the speaker is the user; required for a generic label other than Me. role:
        "answering" when they were pitching or answering questions, "asking" when they mostly asked them. Needs at
        least 300 words from the speaker and at most 15,000 words in all; usually takes under a minute, up to about two minutes when the service is starting up. Clients that
        support MCP Apps also show the visual report.

tools.name: get_transcript_upload_command
tools.description:
Return a curl upload command as text for a prepared local transcript copy. The caller runs the command
        in the user's terminal to send the copy to FounderBrain. This tool only constructs the command; it does not
        open a terminal, read the file, upload data or execute anything.

        path: the full local path of a temporary plain-text copy prepared by the client, containing only speaker turns
        with restricted information removed before upload. The tool does not inspect or clean the file.
        speaker, name and role: the speaker label to analyse, the person's display name when the
        label is generic, and "answering" or "asking". Without a speaker the command only lists the speakers and their
        word counts.

tools.name: check_transcript
tools.description:
List the speakers in a meeting transcript and how many words each said, without scoring anything.

        transcript: the complete prepared transcript, never just a file preview, one speaker turn per line
        ("Name: words"). This tool also receives the text: restricted information must be removed before transfer,
        as described in the server instructions. A user-selected excerpt is allowed.
